Signed integer Morse boundary columns are generated recursively; k=3 and k=5 boundaries are primitive, and k=4 has a 6-to-5 rank-four matrix with a +1 maximal minor and a primitive 7-to-6 kernel generator. The resulting sole reduced integral Betti ranks are respectively (degree,rank)=(1,6),(3,9),(5,4),(9,5), without torsion. CW connectivity, Hurewicz, and homological Whitehead imply the complete sphere wedges. An independent Kneser-model construction checks graph isomorphism and entire mod-two boundary ranks. Codes and outputs are included; no incomplete enumeration is treated as exhaustive.

The full threshold classification is a natural finite object/invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice: it resolves all nontrivial possible matching thresholds, including integral homotopy rather than just finite-field Betti numbers. The distinct dimensions 1,3,5,9 and ranks 6,9,4,5 give a complete matching-number persistence calculation and a concrete comparison for general vanishing bounds and future symmetry/equivariant investigations.
